name: ZeeShare Floating Bar
author: Muhammad Zeeshan

sections.description:
ZeeShare Floating Bar delivers a lightweight floating social share bar that works instantly. Supports 10 niche platforms rarely found together including Snapchat, Threads, and WeChat.

What Makes ZeeShare Floating Bar Different

  • 10 niche platforms: Snapchat, Threads, WeChat + 7 others rarely supported together
  • Lightweight: minimal CSS + jQuery (all assets included)
  • Simple setup: enable + pick position = instant results
  • Fully responsive: works perfectly on mobile devices

Supported Platforms (10 total)

  • Facebook
  • X (Twitter)
  • LinkedIn
  • WhatsApp
  • Telegram
  • Threads
  • Messenger
  • WeChat
  • Snapchat
  • Instagram

Perfect for global audiences needing less common platforms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload zeeshare-floating-bar.zip via Plugins > Add New > Upload
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings > ZeeShare Floating Bar → enable and pick position → Save
  4. Instant results – bar appears on single posts

All assets included – ready to use immediately!
sections.faq:
What makes this different from other share plugins?

10 niche platforms (Snapchat/Threads/WeChat) plus lightweight design in one simple package.

Does it slow my site?

No – uses minimal CSS + jQuery only. All assets included.

Works out-of-box?

Yes – enable and save for an instant floating bar on single posts.

Are the icons customizable?

Yes. Replace PNGs in assets/icons/ (keep exact filenames).

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, fully responsive design.

What WordPress version is required?

WordPress 5.0+ and PHP 7.4+.
